question: In the retina, the center-periphery antagonism of the ganglion cell receptor field causes it:

options.opd: Emissions of the lateral geniculate nucleus.

analysis: The center-periphery antagonism of the ganglion cell receptor field in the retina is primarily mediated by the horizontal cells, which play a crucial role in lateral inhibition and contrast enhancement.
